title: IPA Capital Markets Arranges $50 Million in Financing for 18-Property Industrial Portfolio
body_markdown:
# IPA Capital Markets Arranges $50 Million in Financing for 18-Property Industrial Portfolio


[Download as PDF](https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_c4a5f1de7bc3158dbe369121822e264c/marcusmillichap/news/2026-10-09_IPA_Capital_Markets_Arranges_50_Million_in_466.pdf) October 09, 2026 6:34pm EDT


CHICAGO--(BUSINESS WIRE)--[IPA Capital Markets](https://www.institutionalpropertyadvisors.com/capital-markets) , a division of[Marcus & Millichap (NYSE: MMI)](https://www.marcusmillichap.com/) specializing in capital markets services for major private and institutional clients, **** announced today that Frank Montalto, managing director, and Ethan Splan, director, both based in the firm’s Chicago office, arranged $50 million in financing for an 18-property industrial portfolio located across Texas, Oklahoma and Georgia.


The non-recourse loan features a five-year term, a 70% loan-to-value ratio, a 6.75% interest rate and interest-only payments throughout the loan term.


“This financing reflects the continued strength of well-located industrial assets and the durability of lender demand for stabilized portfolios with strong fundamentals,” said Montalto. “We were pleased to secure non-recourse financing with competitive leverage and pricing that supports the sponsor’s long-term business plan across these markets.”


***About IPA Capital Markets***


*IPA Capital Markets is a division of Marcus & Millichap (NYSE: MMI). IPA Capital Markets provides major private and institutional clients with commercial real estate capital markets financing solutions, including debt, mezzanine financing, preferred and joint venture equity, and sponsor equity. For more information, please visit*[institutionalpropertyadvisors.com/capital-markets](https://www.institutionalpropertyadvisors.com/capital-markets)


***About Marcus & Millichap, Inc. (NYSE: MMI)***


*Marcus & Millichap, Inc. is a leading brokerage firm specializing in commercial real estate investment sales, financing, research and advisory services with offices throughout the United States and Canada. Marcus & Millichap closed 8,818 transactions with a sales volume of $50.8 billion in 2025. The company had 1,808 investment sales and financing professionals in more than 80 offices who provide investment brokerage and financing services to sellers and buyers of commercial real estate at year end.
